key_insight: Scalable compilation of optimized taper states makes high-confidence quantum phase estimation practical with fewer ancilla qubits.
engineering_relevance: Resource-efficient taper preparation can reduce ancilla overhead while keeping small phase-estimation circuits shallow enough for near-term hardware demonstrations.
method: Use tapered QPE with resolution qubits plus a few confidence qubits, yielding failure probability that decays double exponentially with confidence-qubit count.
Compile optimally concentrated DPSS (Slepian) taper states using scalable tensor-network methods.
Provide a circuit database spanning 1–50 resolution qubits and 1–4 confidence qubits.
evidence_signal: On Quantinuum H2-2, tQPE experiments with a one-qubit system initialized in its ground state demonstrated 3×–18× lower failure probability for 1–10 resolution qubits.
watch_item: Hardware validation covers a one-qubit system and small registers; performance for larger systems and compiled tapers remains to be demonstrated.
paper_title: Scalable Compilation of Resource-Efficient Tapers for High-Confidence Quantum Phase Estimation
